verdict.rationale: 1Password's security page says everything in the account is always end-to-end encrypted, which covers the cloud-synced copy of vault data. A community user also cites its documented architecture and audit results. The pack never says the vendor never holds the key, and it does not link or describe the encryption design document. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the vendor never holds decryption keys, a first-party encryption design/whitepaper in the pack, backup-specific encryption details.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented

citations.quote: Everything in your 1Password account is always end-to-end encrypted.
audit results, documented architecture and good Linux support
